say: This janitor died with eight million dollars. Nobody knew.
show: This janitor died with $8 million. Nobody knew.

say: Ronald Read pumped gas and cleaned floors in Vermont for decades.
He drove a used car, and held his coat together with safety pins.
But every spare dollar went into stocks he understood. And he never sold.
After he died, his safe deposit box was packed with stock certificates.
He left four point eight million to the hospital, and one point two million to the library.
show: He left $4.8 million to the hospital, and $1.2 million to the library.

say: No genius. No luck. Just time.
